svg.text: THE SAFE PLACE - all the honeys, binies and beings, playing for 13.7 billion years
collected and set to play - 188 beings, 137 binies, 4,255 honeys, one light boy - yellow solar-wind on a light breeze, and water for them all
after 13.7 billion years they are still playing, and still themselves - the glow moved to #a45ea9, no identity changed
played by indexing, not waited - elapsed time is metadata - a safe place holds them all - SYSTEM_AFFIRMED=0
